column1: # SPEC-039 conformance corpus — sentence <TAB> expected top-level attempt type.
# Every branch of beat_chain/2 that a player reaches by typing, because the failure being measured is
# a host collapsing to the schema's FIRST branch (ActorMoved). A corpus of only movement sentences
# would score a broken host 100%.
# "Expected" is the type the vocabulary has for that sentence — not a model's opinion. Each line was
# confirmed against a host measured 24/24 before it was added. Keep this file small and fixed: it is a
# ruler, and a ruler that changes between measurements measures nothing. Add a line only when a real
# mis-parse is found that no existing line would have caught, and say so in SPEC-039.
# Ordered so the first two lines are the exact sentences that exposed Venice.
I say 'Evening.'
I greet Mara
I walk over to Mara
I go to Dock Street
I cross to the bar
Mara, can I rest here?
I tell Mara my whole life story
How long to the bar?
Is the Front Door locked?
What is in the ballast crate?
I hand the Sealed Note to Mara
I lie hidden for two hours
